info.title: Udofin API
info.description: Versioned HTTP API of the Udofin lending service provider platform. Errors use RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable `code`. Only implemented endpoints are listed.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: The process is up. Never touches dependencies, so restarts are not triggered by them.

get.summary: Readiness probe
get.description: Every dependency answers within two seconds. Reports dependency names only, never error text.

get.summary: Current identity, memberships and permissions
get.description: Identity and permissions are resolved from the database on every request, never from the token. Staff sessions must have completed the second factor (aal2).

401.description: Not authenticated, or a staff session without the second factor

post.summary: File a change request
post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key. A repeat with the same key and body returns the original response; the same key with a different body is refused with 422 idempotency_key_reused.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16 to 128 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). Retrying with the same key and the same request returns the original result; the same key with a different request returns 422.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present and "true" when this response is a stored replay.

401.description: Not authenticated, or a staff session without the second factor

422.description: Validation failed, or an idempotency key was reused with a different request
